scope: 12 authored English integration queries across the entire public Markdown corpus; top 3 rank with exact normalized evidence. Not a model answer evaluation.

questions.query: Is there a Ruxbase npm SDK or should I use the official PocketBase JavaScript client?
evidence: not a separate Ruxbase npm SDK

questions.query: Is the GitHub Pages URL the application server or do I use the Ruxbase server origin?
